description: Artboard display options (Artboard Options: Show Center Mark, Show Cross Hairs, Show Video Safe Areas, Video Ruler Pixel Aspect Ratio, ruler origin), the artboard border and name display (application preferences, for every document), and the View menu's Show / Hide Artboards and Show / Hide Video Rulers. With no options, reports the current settings

rulerOrigin.description: Zero point of the artboard's rulers, in points from its top-left corner

rulerPixelAspectRatio.description: Pixel aspect ratio of the video rulers, e.g. 1 for square pixels

showCenter.description: Show a mark at the centre

showCrossHairs.description: Show lines through the centre of each edge

showNames.description: Show artboard names on the canvas (all documents)

showSafeAreas.description: Show video title-safe and action-safe areas

toggleArtboards.description: Run View > Show / Hide Artboards, which switches artboard outlines on or off

toggleVideoRulers.description: Run View > Rulers > Show / Hide Video Rulers, which switches them on or off

name: set_artboard_display
title: Set Artboard Display
